home.f_bio_body: 22 blocks —buttons, socials, videos, music, text— with 10 themes and 8 typefaces. Ready in minutes from your phone.
home.f_short_body: With start and end dates, click limits, password and UTM parameters. Files, contact cards and events too.
home.f_qr_body: With your colors, shapes and logo. Dynamic: change the destination and the printed QR keeps working.
home.f_stats_body: Views, countries, devices and referrers without storing IP addresses or using tracking cookies.
home.free_body: tubio's code is public under the AGPL license. You can review it, improve it or run it on your own server.
